verdict.rationale: dlt is an open-source Python library whose core function is loading data into open, standard destinations (DuckDB, Parquet/CSV/JSONL files, standard SQL databases) that the user fully owns, and its destination-agnostic pipeline design lets users switch destinations without changing pipeline code, avoiding lock-in. It also exposes data via dataset()/SQL/Ibis/dataframes for further open access. Missing for 10: no explicit one-command 'export everything and leave' workflow, and dltHub's managed/hosted layer (SaaS orchestration, Playground) is not confirmed to be equally portable/open as the core library.
